Item.Description: Workflow: restriction applies to all tasks in this workflow only
Job: restriction applies to all tasks in this job
Pre-requisites: restriction applies only to tasks within the same workflow and its direct pre-requisite workflows in the same job
Post-requisites: restriction applies only to tasks within the same workflow and its direct post-requisite workflows in the same job
Child: restriction applies only to tasks within the same workflow and its direct child workflows in the same job
